show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/fw7PYa
show.description: In a famine-stricken kingdom of Bhopal, on the brink of war in 1981, a starving old man Bundu Khan discovers a mysterious spirit that grants his deepest wishes. To escape being sent to die in battle, he impulsively marries three cousin sisters and promises them safety. But as Bundu grows younger and stronger with every act of love and compassion, enemies, betrayal, and war close in—testing whether this unlikely family can survive together. Watch Now!
